tools.name: search_offers
tools.description: Search live hosting offers across ~75 providers by RAM, vCPU, price, country and type. Prices are rescraped daily, so they are at most a day old. Returns a claim_url for each offer that the HUMAN should open in their browser to sign up.

tools.name: get_offer
tools.description: Full detail for a single offer by its id, including the claim_url the human should open.

tools.name: list_providers
tools.description: Every provider in the catalogue, with a signup_url for each. Use this when the question is about a brand rather than a specific plan.
